tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa nyung gsal bzhugs so// ༈ /rnam dag dkyil 'khor bzhi yi 'dzin ma la// rnam dkar dbang bzhi'i char rgyun legs phab nas// rnam grol sku bzhi'i lo tog rgyas mdzad pa// rnam mkhyen bla ma bzhi la gsol ba 'debs// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang bdag med ma// mthu stobs dbang phyug grub chen nag po pa// ḍā ma rū pa a wa dhū tī pa// ga ya dha ra rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla chen 'brog mi se ston kun rig dang*// zhang ston chos 'bar dpal ldan sa skya pa// rje btsun sku mched chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta// chos rgyal 'phags pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams dpal// bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs/

'di nas sh+lau ka phyed bzhi 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos mdzad pa'o/ /bud+dhā shrī dang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// sems dpa' chen po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// brgyud gsol kun bsdus bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*// kun spang chos rje blo gsal rgya mtsho'i zhabs// mkhyen brtse dbang phyug bslab gsum rgyal mtshan zhabs// dbang phyug rab brtan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams mchog ldan bsod nams mchog sgrub dang*// mkhyen rab byams pa rmor chen gnas gsar rje// kun dga' blo gros nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// kun dga' bstan 'dzin rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// blo gros snying po kun dga' 'jam dbyangs zhabs// blo gter dbang po chos kyi nyi ma rje// gzhan phan snying po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin brlabs kyis// nges 'byung byang chub sems gnyis snying la shar// 'bras bu'i yon tan thos pas yid spro ste// gsang chen lam la 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// bskyed pa phyi dbyibs rdul tshon dkyil 'khor du// bum pa'i dbang bskur bskyed rim lam bsgoms pas// rtsa yi 'gros kyis lus kyi sgrib sbyangs nas// sprul sku'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// bha ga byang sems nang gi dkyil 'khor du// gsang ba'i dbang bskur gtum mo'i lam bsgoms pas// yi ge'i 'gros kyis ngag gi sgrib sbyangs nas// longs sku'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// kun rdzob byang sems gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du// gsum pa'i dbang bskur pho nya'i lam bsgoms pas// bdud rtsi'i 'gros kyis yid kyi sgrib sbyangs nas// chos sku'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// don dam byang sems mthar thug dkyil 'khor du// bzhi pa'i dbang bskur rba rlabs lam bsgoms pas// rlung gi 'gros kyis sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs nas// ngo bo nyid sku thob par byin gyis rlobs//

gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i gzhung 'di ni shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// // de ma thob pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du// mthun rkyen rgyal bas bsngags pa kun tshang nas// bsam don chos dang mthun pa legs 'grub ste// srid zhi'i phun tshogs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / sh+lau ka 'dimakhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis mdzad pa'o// thos pa rgya mtsho'i mchod yon kun nas 'khyil// yon tan me tog tshul khrims bdug spos sprin// shes rab sgron me dad pa spos chu'i mtsho// ting 'dzin bdud rtsi'i zhal zas dam pa dang*// bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i sil snyan sgra 'byin cing*// kun nas snying brtse rnam dpyod spobs pa yi// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bsgreng ba yis// bdag lus gzhal med khang brtsegs rab brgyan te// snying ga'i chu skyes thig le zla rgyas la// brtan par bzhugs pa'i chos rje mchod byed cing*// nges par 'dun pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na// 'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu mnyes gyur cig / ces pa 'di chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'o// skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du// rigs bzang blo gsal nga rgyal med pa dang*// snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus ldan// dpal ldan bla ma'i dam tshig la gnas shog /bdag sogs gdul byar gyur pa thams cad kyang*// las 'bras lhur len gsung rab don la mkhas// tshul khrims dag cing thos la mngon brtson pas// thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzad du gsol// rgyal mtshan rtse mor dbang gi rgyal po ltar// lhag pa lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gcig pu// sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad// mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog// /dge'o//
// ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
